description: This Java class 'StagedCommand' represents a non-serializable, local-only command used for multi-stage processing within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence layer. It encapsulates a sequence of actions, some asynchronous, and provides methods for managing command state, including creating, modifying, and iterating over actions.

classes.name: StagedCommand
classes.description: A class representing a staged, multi-action command used internally for processing connectivity commands in Eclipse Ditto. It supports iteration over actions, state modification, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StagedCommand instance with specified command, event, response, and actions.

methods.name: dummyEvent
methods.description: Returns a dummy placeholder event indicating a connection closure.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the wrapped connectivity command.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns the event to be persisted or published.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response headers to send.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the original sender ActorRef.

methods.name: withSenderUnlessDefined
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with the specified sender if none was set.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with the specified response headers.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the connection entity ID from the wrapped command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the category of the command.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the Ditto headers from the wrapped command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to JSON with specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the command's manifest string.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the command's type string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on command, event, response, sender, and actions.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on internal fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the staged command.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are remaining actions.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with the next action removed.

methods.name: nextAction
methods.description: Returns the next action without modifying the state.
